title: Planning the Tables

readiness.math: ordering the steps of a job
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Big news! For the harvest, all the neighbors will eat supper together in the square. We'll need long tables and benches!

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Tobias and I will build them, with your help. First, let's plan: what do we do first, and what comes next?

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Put the steps in order: what do we do first?
steps.hint: What must happen before we can cut the wood?

feedback.out_of_order: Some steps came back. Which must come first?
feedback.all_good: Plan, measure, saw, nail, paint. That's how good work is done!

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: With a plan, even a big job is just one step after another.

journal_line: I helped Mr. Amos plan how to build tables for the harvest supper.
